How to get there
From Coates Kingston — about 55 km by road, about 64 min. Sat nav: -27.984717, 153.428026 — the same point as Navigate (master plan).
Come over the Sundale Bridge. That is the way in for trucks on this job.
Come in here: TEDDER AVE ACCESS POINT, HEAVY VEHICLE ENTRY ONLY, LIGHT VEHICLE EXIT ONLY.
Do not drive through the park unescorted. Pull up at the gate and wait.
From that gate, head south-east about 515 m. The wide photo is what you are looking at.
